theater_main_quest_01_09_04_009:
I refuse to be some loudmouth jerk
who's all talk—
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_010:
Some guy who'll sacrifice others,
but won't put his own body on the line...!!
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_036:
He's breathing, but—
the wounds are deep.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_037: Lion, I'm leaving things here to you.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_038: Lady Chigusa, I leave the rest to you.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_040: Buy us as much time as you can.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_041: Bell will wake up. I know he will.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_042: He'll wake up, and he'll beat that monster.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_044:
You saw it too, didn't you?!
Bell can do this!
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_048: Bell, wake up! Open your eyes, Bell!
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_051:
Everyone's fighting—
against something that terrifying.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_052: You can do it. You're the only one who can!
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_053: The only one who can save everybody!
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_056: (Goddess... I know. I can hear you.)
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_057:
(But my body... no matter what...
my body won't move!)
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_061:
If there's anything that earns someone
the right to be called a hero—
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_062:
It isn't taking up the sword, nor raising
the shield, nor bringing healing.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_063:
Only one who stakes their very self
deserves to be called a hero.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_064:
Protect your comrades. Save the girl.
Stake your very self.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_065:
It's fine if you break. It's fine if you falter.
Cry all you want.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_066: The victor is always found among the defeated.
theater_main_quest_01_09_04_068: Shout out what's in your heart.
theater_main_quest_01_09_05_001: So I won't shame that person.
theater_main_quest_01_09_05_002: And above all, so I can save my precious friends.
theater_main_quest_01_09_05_015:
"Distant forest sky.
Infinite stars strewn across the endless night."
theater_main_quest_01_09_05_016:
She's chanting... in the middle of
a high-speed battle...?!
theater_main_quest_01_09_05_017:
"Answer my foolish voice, and grant once more
the blessing of starfire. Show the mercy of
light to those who forsook you."
theater_main_quest_01_09_05_019:
"O mighty god of war, whom I dare speak of,
who shatters all things, O guidance from
the noble heavens."
theater_main_quest_01_09_05_020:
"Grant this lowly body
your towering divine power."
theater_main_quest_01_09_05_021: I know it's a selfish thing to ask.
theater_main_quest_01_09_05_022: But there's a friend I want to save!
theater_main_quest_01_09_06_013: Mr. Bell! Mr. Bell did it!!
theater_main_quest_01_09_06_019:
Ah... Ahh!
I saw it! I, Hermes, saw it with my own eyes!!
theater_main_quest_01_09_06_020:
No talent?!
Don't be absurd, great Zeus!
theater_main_quest_01_09_06_021:
Your grandson—your parting gift—
is the real deal!
theater_main_quest_01_09_06_022:
He's the Last Hero
left behind by your Familia!
theater_main_quest_01_09_06_023: It's starting! The era is moving!
theater_main_quest_01_09_06_024:
No matter what, I'll see it all
with my own eyes.
theater_main_quest_01_09_06_025:
The great events that will happen here in Orario—
the ones that will be carved into history!
theater_main_quest_01_09_06_026: The fate of these heroes, their lives and deaths!
theater_main_quest_01_09_06_027: The tale spun by our beloved children—
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_001:
Now then, my girls.
Night has fallen.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_002:
Take your clients, entertain your men, let desire
clash with desire. Feast on love to your hearts'
content again tonight!!
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_003: I-I'll be turning in early today!
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_004:
Okay, good night.
Okaaay, good niiight!
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_007:
Haven't shadowed anyone like this
since my thieving days.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_009:
She's been acting strange lately.
I knew something was up.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_010:
She's like a certain someone—
easy to read.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_012: So she's with Lady Chigusa after all.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_017:
Yeah. The nighttime district.
The red-light district, in other words.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_019:
I see. If this is where they were headed,
no wonder they couldn't tell us.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_020:
What could they be after?
This place couldn't be further from those two.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_021:
Anyway, let's go. It gets crowded up ahead.
Don't lose them.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_023:
Sigh...
I never wanted Mr. Bell to set foot
in a place like this as long as he lived...
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_026:
Still... nothing's changed.
Not the sights, not the smell.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_028:
My old coworkers just dragged me along.
It wasn't my thing, so I left right away.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_032:
But where the heck are they going... Whoa!
Crap, come on.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_035: Your wait is over! It's service tiiime!
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_036:
Wha?! Hey, wait a sec!
Welf, Lili!!
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_038:
Th-thanks to you, we're safe.
Thank you so much.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_065: But Lady Lili, why are you all here?
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_039:
You two were acting strange, so—forgive me—
we followed you.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_040:
We're all in the same Familia now, for better
or worse. Don't keep secrets.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_042:
P-please don't blame Mikoto.
It was my idea...
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_044:
The truth is... Lady Chigusa heard a rumor that
a friend from our homeland is working here,
in the pleasure quarter.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_045: Working, meaning... that kind of work, huh.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_047:
She's a dear friend we played with as kids.
But she went missing a few years ago.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_049:
Unlike us, she's of noble birth.
I could hardly believe someone like her
would be in the pleasure quarter...
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_050:
So before consulting all of you,
we came to see for ourselves.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_052:
I understand the situation.
But you shouldn't come here so carelessly.
theater_main_quest_02_01_01_054:
Anyway, let's leave this place.
We'll gather more info about her later—
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_007:
Heh. Fancy meeting you in a place like this.
You're at that age, aren't you, Bell?
Got your eye on a particular girl?
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_008:
Oh, no, it's not like that...
What are you doing here, Lord Hermes?
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_009:
Now, now, don't ask such tactless questions.
Keep the fact that I was here strictly between
us, okay? It's a promise.
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_016:
Well then, Bell!
Let's both have ourselves a fun night!
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_031:
Just found him right here.
Look at that innocent face.
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_034:
Hm? Hey, hey, Aisha.
Isn't this human the Little Rookie?
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_036: From that War Game the other day?
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_037: It's him all right. White hair, red eyes.
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_038:
The Record Holder who leveled up
faster than anyone in history.
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_039:
I spotted him first.
I'm not handing him over to anyone.
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_041:
Please wait!
I only came here looking for
a friend from my Familia...!
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_047: One guest to the home, right this waaay!
theater_main_quest_02_01_02_048:
Um, you've got it wrong.
I can't explain, but you've got it all wroooong!!
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_001:
Please, have mercy!
That's not why I came here!
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_005: Is that human tonight's prey, Aisha?
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_007: Lady Ishtar, don't look at him!!
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_008:
We can't have you charming our prey
and stealing him from us again!
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_009:
Heh... I have a client coming tonight.
I've no time for some green boy.
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_010:
(So that's Lady Ishtar—
which means this is the Ishtar Familia's home?!)
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_011:
The Ishtar Familia is one of
the most powerful Familias in Orario.
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_012: There are lots of reasons for that, but—
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_013: You don't need to know about them, Bell!
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_014:
(So, what does that mean—
what does that MEEEAN?!)
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_020:
All the rooms are full, so you'll wait here till
one opens up. Not that I'd mind getting started
right here, mind you.
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_021:
Eep?!
I-isn't this a bad idea?
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_022:
I'm from a different Familia, and, um,
inviting an adventurer into your home
so carelessly is—
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_024:
Don't you know Amazon habits?
We snatch up men and devour them.
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_027:
Hehehe...
Will you get to go home tomorrow morning,
or the day after?
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_028:
We'll suck you dry,
till you're completely spent.
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_033: What are you doing here, Phryne?!
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_034:
Is that any way to talk
to your Familia's captain, Aisha?
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_035:
I saw it, I saw it—the War Game.
Getting to eat the Little Rookie?
What a lovely treat.
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_037:
Don't screw with us!
We caught this prey ourselves!
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_038:
There are fewer and fewer men worthy of me.
I'm bored. Surely a little taste is fine?
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_039:
Do you know how many men have been
left useless after one of your "tastes"?!
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_040:
Means nobody but me can satisfy 'em, right?
Being this beautiful is a sin.
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_041:
Lady Ishtar's not bad herself,
but she can't hold a candle to me.
theater_main_quest_02_01_03_046:
What a pain. Let's settle this
the Amazon way.
theater_main_quest_02_01_04_002:
(I just know it—if they catch me, I'll never be
the same! My dreams, my hopes, my yearning,
all crushed. Bell Cranel will be finished.)
theater_main_quest_02_01_04_018:
I have been expecting you, master.
Tonight, I shall be your companion.
My name is Haruhime.
theater_main_quest_02_01_04_023:
Huh, ah, wha, ah, wai, ha, no, um, I'm, it's
not—whoa?!
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_002:
Not only did I mistake you for a client,
I made such a disgraceful scene...
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_003:
N-no, not at all. I'm the one who
barged in uninvited.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_004: My name is Haruhime. And you are...?
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_006:
Master Cranel, then.
If you're not a client, Master Cranel,
why have you come to the pleasure quarter?
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_009: I see. So Aisha and the others were chasing you...
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_013:
It would be hard for a newcomer to slip out of here.
When dawn comes, I'll guide you to a hidden path.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_015:
Yes. This meeting may last but one night,
but Haruhime wishes to be of help to you,
Master Cranel.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_018:
In exchange, if I may be so bold...
would you talk with me until then?
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_020:
So you came to Orario to become an adventurer,
Master Cranel?
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_021:
Yeah. I had a... dream, sort of.
And I didn't have any money, either.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_022:
I see. I came here from the Far East
for reasons of my own.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_024:
Yes. A land rich in nature, with four distinct
seasons. But when I was eleven,
my family disowned me.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_025:
Disowned... You mean your father
cut all ties with you?
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_026:
I incurred my father's wrath.
There was nothing to be done.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_027:
After that, many things happened, and I was
sold here, to the pleasure quarter—
to the Ishtar Familia.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_028:
B-but I did long to see the Labyrinth City,
Orario.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_029:
Even in the Far East, there are many tales
set in this land.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_031:
Yes! And others too, like the one where a knight
from a foreign land journeys through a labyrinth
in search of the Holy Grail.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_036: Wait, do you like hero stories too, Miss Haruhime?
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_039:
I'm sure you know this already, but not a word
of this matter to anyone.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_040:
I know where the lines are. I don't intend to
betray your trust. But what are you planning
to do with this?
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_042: I just happened to catch a glimpse.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_043:
Before long, I'll show you something fun.
That goddess who plays at being queen,
groveling in the dirt.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_045:
Hermes, don't you have any information
that would please me? That woman's weaknesses?
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_046:
If I did, I'd have told you long ago.
I could never lie before a goddess of beauty—
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_049:
"Lost Dilardo" and "The Holy Legend of Gergio."
You've read so many stories, Miss Haruhime.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_050:
You're the amazing one, Master Cranel.
You truly know everything.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_051:
I only know hero stories.
You seem to know a lot about other tales too.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_052:
Even so, my favorite stories are also
tales of heroes.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_053:
There's an old story from the Far East, about
a samurai who, though small, saved a maiden
from an ogre.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_055:
I wish that, just like in the books, a hero would
take me by the hand and lead me out into
the world I've always longed for—
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_056:
But that's merely a shameless fantasy.
I'm not worthy of being taken away.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_058:
A hero wouldn't abandon someone like you.
There's no way you're not worthy—
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_060:
But I am neither a lovely princess,
nor a pitiful saint offered as a sacrifice.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_064:
I have not guarded my chastity by force of will.
I have sold my body for money.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_065:
Why would they come to rescue one as lowly as me?
To a hero, a prostitute is a symbol of ruin.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_067:
I'm not allowed to have dreams.
I'm only a prostitute.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_068:
...It's time now.
I had a truly wonderful time. Thank you.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_069:
Follow this path and you'll come out on
Daedalus Street. Aisha shouldn't find you there.
theater_main_quest_02_01_05_075: You'll catch cold. Let's go back.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_001:
You went to the red-light district
and came home the next MORNING?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_003:
L-Lady Hestia?! As I said, it's all my fault!
Sir Bell did nothing wrong...!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_004: You stay out of this, Mikoto.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_006:
Sooo... Bell.
Does that mean you went and did
THAT kind of thing?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_011:
A-anyway!
I didn't do anything weird at all!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_014:
No one can lie in front of a god.
Bell isn't lying.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_016:
BUT I'm not forgiving you for going there!
Or rather, I can't forgive you for being
interested in a place like that at all!!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_019:
You're getting punished!
Community service for the neighborhood!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_021:
Sigh...
I made the goddess mad...
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_023:
Hey, you monster!
Let the princess go!!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_027:
Why would they come to rescue
one as lowly as me?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_028: I couldn't say anything to her...
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_032:
Huh?!
But this is my punishment...
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_033:
If it's about going to the red-light district,
we're just as guilty.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_034:
We're responsible too. Though Lili is
curious what you were doing till morning...
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_036:
It's all because I acted on my own...
I'm truly sorry, Sir Bell...
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_037:
Don't worry about it, Miss Mikoto!
But why did you go to the red-light district?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_038:
I was searching for a certain Renard...
I'd heard a rumor that she was in that district.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_042:
—!! How do you know that?!
Do you know something?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_043:
Huh?! Ah, uh, well...
The thing is...
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_044:
I see...
I'd hoped it couldn't be true, but...
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_045:
So Lady Haruhime really was in the pleasure
quarter... Someone so pure...
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_047:
Please don't even think about
going to rescue her.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_050:
The War Game just ended,
and you want to start another fight?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_051: That would put a huge burden on Lady Hestia!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_052:
Heh... Hey, Li'l E!
You don't have to play the bad guy alone.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_054:
As a member of the Familia, I agree with Li'l E.
We can't put the Familia in danger.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_055:
...They're both right, Sir Bell.
Please, forget about this.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_056:
Please, Mia!!
Give Lady Freya a message for me!!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_057:
You barge in out of nowhere and say what?
Do that kind of thing yourself.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_058:
This time it's life or death for me!
At this rate, Bell's going to be in danger
in more ways than one!!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_060: Ishtar has her eye on Bell!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_061:
Huh?!
Why is THAT goddess getting involved?!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_062:
It couldn't be helped!
It's not my faaault!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_063:
What do you mean, Bell's in danger?
Lord Hermes!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_065:
And how did Lady Ishtar even learn about Bell?
Don't tell me YOU took Bell to the
red-light district, Lord Hermes...?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_066:
N-no, of course not...!
I swear it on my divinity!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_067:
Really...?!
Can you swear you had nothing to do with it?!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_068:
S-Syr!
A mere town girl shouldn't scare a god like that!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_074:
I can tell from that face. I'm your adviser,
after all. Tell me anything!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_076:
You went to the red-light district
and came home the next MORNING?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_078:
W-well, you ARE a boy, Bell...
I get that you'd be interested in that
kind of thing... but, but...!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_079:
No, it's still a no! You are NOT allowed
to go to places like that!!
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_081:
So, you wanted to know about
the Ishtar Familia?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_083:
It's a top-class Familia, both in Dungeon
exploration and in business.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_085:
In particular, their captain, Phryne Jamil,
is a Level 5 first-tier adventurer.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_087:
Apparently even Ms. Wallenstein
nearly lost to her once.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_089:
That was years ago, though.
Back then, Ms. Jamil was a higher level.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_091:
Um, do you know anything about an Amazon
named Aisha, or a Renard named Haruhime?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_092:
Aisha Belka is well known.
She's Level 3, but people say she's close
to leveling up.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_093:
The other one, the Renard... hmm... she isn't
on the roster. Maybe she's a low-level
noncombatant. Why, is something on your mind?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_095:
Listen, Bell.
This isn't something I can say too loudly, but...
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_097:
About five years ago, the Ishtar Familia
was accused by multiple Familias.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_098:
They claimed the members were far stronger
than the official levels reported to the Guild.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_099: You mean they were lying about their strength?
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_100:
Yeah... So the Guild investigated, but they came
up clean. But it didn't end there...
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_102:
Ishtar countersued the Familias that accused her.
They were hit with penalties, lost their power,
and in the end, many were destroyed.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_110:
Bell, the Ishtar Familia is even more
frightening than its strength suggests.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_111:
If you can, you should stay away from them
from now on.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_113:
If I get any more involved with the Ishtar Familia,
I'll cause trouble for the goddess and everyone.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_128:
No. I was only dreaming a little.
A dream that will never come true...
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_129:
I saw a traveling merchant selling these.
Said they're sweets from the Far East.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_130:
Oh, heh...
You're always so good to me. Thank you.
theater_main_quest_02_02_01_131: Don't go thanking me for something like this.
theater_main_quest_02_02_02_002:
Yes. But she rejected me.
She said she didn't know anyone like me.
theater_main_quest_02_02_02_003:
Ah... um, Miss Mikoto!
What was Miss Haruhime like back
